version.promotionalText: Schedule coaching, invite clients, meet, record locally, edit from the transcript, and keep shared notes, tasks, and goals moving—without stitching together five apps.
version.description:
Your coaching practice, from booking to follow-through.

Quipsly Capture brings the session and the work it creates into one simple place. Schedule a coaching call, invite your client, meet from iPhone or the web, and preserve high-quality participant recordings without asking either person to manage a production workflow.

After the conversation, Quipsly keeps everything connected:
• Record locally at each end while you talk
• Recover and sync protected recordings after an interruption
• Read a speaker-attributed transcript tied to the recording timeline
• Correct the words, trim the timeline, and make basic text-based edits
• Preview and share a clean session recording
• Turn the conversation into editable notes, tasks, and goals
• Collaborate with your client in the same private Session space
• See upcoming sessions and follow-through from Today

Clients join your Sessions free. They can use the invitation on a phone, tablet, or computer, participate in the call, and work with the notes and next steps you share.

Your original recording stays protected while edits remain reversible. If the network drops or the app closes, Quipsly keeps recoverable local work and continues when you reconnect.

Quipsly also supports podcast sessions, interviews, research, and any conversation that needs to become useful work. Some calling, syncing, transcription, and sharing features require an internet connection.

review.credentialStorage: App Store Connect App Review Information only
review.whatToTest: Sign in with the supplied reviewer account. Try Speak to write: make a short recording, stop, open the editable writing, correct a word, and confirm the original audio remains connected. Open the supplied synthetic coaching Session, join its call, make a short local recording, and confirm Library playback and transcript access. Create and edit a note, task, or goal. Confirm Account exposes Privacy and Request Account Deletion. Do not use private client, podcast, or unpublished source material.

shippingFacts: No advertising, gambling, loot boxes, open web browser, or public social feed.
No anonymous public chat or stranger matching.
The app can record and privately share user-provided audio, video, notes, and session work with authorized collaborators.
The app does not author violent, sexual, drug, or medical-treatment content, but user-provided coaching and podcast material may discuss ordinary real-world topics.
Social media capability is not exposed in the shipping iPhone app.
